H1201.derivation: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness;

H1202.derivation: from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah;

H1203.derivation: from H6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה) (as singular of H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת)) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth;
H1203.def: Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan

H1209.def: Betsai, the name of two Israelites

H1211.derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel;

H1212.derivation: probably from H6738 (צֵל) and H410 (אֵל) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God;
H1212.def: Betsalel, the name of two Israelites

H1213.derivation: or בַּצְלִית; from the same as H1211 (בֶּצֶל)xlit bᵉtsel corrected to betsel; a peeling;

H1214.derivation: a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder;
H1214.kjv: (be) covet(-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded.

H1216.def: perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister

H1218.derivation: from H1216 (בָּצֵק); a swell of ground;

H1219.derivation: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from H1210 (בָּצִיר))
H1219.def: to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification)
H1219.kjv: cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.

H1220.def: strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out)

H1221.derivation: the same as H1220 (בֶּצֶר), an inaccessible spot;
H1221.def: Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite

H1227.derivation: the same as H1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq;

H1228.def: a bottle (from the gurgling in emptying)

H1229.derivation: from H1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq and H3050 (יָהּ); emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah;

H1231.def: Bukki, the name of two Israelites

H1232.derivation: from H1238 (בָּקַק) and H3050 (יָהּ); wasting of Jah;

H1234.def: to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open
H1234.kjv: make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.

H1235.def: a section (half) of ashekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin)

H1236.def: {properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains}

H1237.def: properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains

H1238.def: to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine)

H1239.def: properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider

H1240.def: {properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider}

H1241.def: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
H1241.kjv: beeve, bull ([phrase] -ock), [phrase] calf, [phrase] cow, great (cattle), [phrase] heifer, herd, kine, ox.

H1242.def: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning

H1245.def: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H1245.kjv: ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).

H1250.derivation: or בַּר; from H1305 (בָּרַר) (in the sense of winnowing);
H1250.def: grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extension the open country

H1253.def: vegetable lye (from its cleansing); used as a soap forwashing, or a flux formetals

H1254.def: (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes)
H1254.kjv: choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).

H1256.derivation: from H1254 (בָּרָא) and H8050 (שְׁמוּאֵל); Jah has created;

H1260.def: Bered, the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite

H1262.derivation: a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from H1250 (בָּר)) to feed; also (as equivalent to H1305 (בָּרַר)) to render clear (Ecclesiastes 3:18)
H1262.def: to select; to feed; to render clear

H1263.def: Baruk, the name of three Israelites

H1265.def: a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood)

H1268.derivation: or בֵּרֹתַי; probably from H1266 (בְּרוֹת)lemma בֻּרוֹת first vowel, corrected to בְּרוֹת; cypress or cypresslike;
H1268.def: Berothah or Berothai, a place north of Palestine

H1269.derivation: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes;

H1270.derivation: perhaps from the root of H1269 (בִּרְזוֹת);
H1270.def: iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement

H1271.def: Barzillai, the name of three Israelites

H1272.def: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
H1272.kjv: chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot.

H1273.def: a Barchumite, or native of Bachurim

H1276.def: (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine

H1277.derivation: from H1254 (בָּרָא) (in the sense of H1262 (בָּרָה));

H1281.def: a fugitive, i.e. the serpent (as fleeing), and the constellation by that name

H1283.derivation: apparently from the feminine of H7451 (רַע) with a prepositional prefix; in trouble;
H1283.def: Beriah, the name of four Israelites

H1284.def: a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah

H1285.derivation: from H1262 (בָּרָה) (in the sense of cutting (like H1254 (בָּרָא)));
H1285.def: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)

H1288.def: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H1288.kjv: [idiom] abundantly, [idiom] altogether, [idiom] at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, [idiom] greatly, [idiom] indeed, kneel (down), praise, salute, [idiom] still, thank.

H1289.def: {to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)}

H1292.derivation: from H1288 (בָרַךְ) and H410 (אֵל), God has blessed;
H1292.def: Barakel, the father of one of Job's friends

H1294.def: Berakah, the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine

H1295.def: a reservoir (at which camels kneel as a resting-place)

H1296.derivation: or בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ; from H1290 (בֶּרֶךְ) and H3050 (יָהּ); knee (i.e. blessing) of Jah;
H1296.def: Berekjah, the name of six Israelites

H1297.derivation: (Aramaic) perhaps from H7313 (רוּם) with a prepositional prefix;
H1297.def: properly, highly, i.e. surely; but used adversatively, however
